_description: Rank a bounded set of candidate options (dates, products, vendors, headlines) so the agent only spends deep effort on the top few.
_example: Flight dates: state lists 92 candidate days with prices; Jev picks best month (choice, conf 1.0), best day (choice, conf 0.67), and a book-now signal (noul 0.82). See examples/flights-sep-2026.md.
_policy: rankable=yes (conf>=0.80) -> rank cheaply, deep-dive only top-N per topn. decide_now=yes (conf>=0.80) -> choose now and report. Otherwise research_capped.

decide_now.instructions: Is there enough signal to pick a winner now without further research?

rankable.instructions: Is this a bounded set of comparable options that can be ranked cheaply before any deep per-option work?

topn.instructions: How many top options deserve deep follow-up work?

_state_template.goal: <what the best option must satisfy, one line>
